skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the economic aspects of natural resource management, allocation, and conservation.
Apply economic principles to solve real-world problems in natural resource management.
Develop independent thinking and responsibility in group work.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations on professional issues.
Conduct research and analyze data related to natural resource economics.
Identify and solve economic problems related to natural resource management.
Work effectively in teams and contribute to group projects.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on natural resource economics topics.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for exams.
